SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN score >= 90 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 优秀, SUM(CASE WHEN score >= 80 AND score < 90 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 良好, SUM(CASE WHEN score >= 70 AND score < 80 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 中等, SUM(CASE WHEN score >= 60 AND score < 70 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 及格, SUM(CASE WHEN score < 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 不及格 FROM Score

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN score >= 90 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 优秀, SUM(CASE WHEN score >= 80 AND score < 90 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 良好, SUM(CASE WHEN score >= 70 AND score < 80 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 中等, SUM(CASE WHEN score >= 60 AND score < 70 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 及格, SUM(CASE WHEN score < 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 不及格 FROM Score WHERE stu_id = #{stuId}

SELECT co.course_name, CAST(AVG(sc.score) AS DECIMAL(5,2)) AS avg_score FROM Score sc JOIN Course co ON sc.course_id = co.course_id WHERE sc.exam_type = N'期末' GROUP BY co.course_name ORDER BY co.course_name
SELECT co.course_name, sc.score FROM Score sc JOIN Course co ON sc.course_id = co.course_id WHERE sc.stu_id = #{stuId} AND sc.exam_type = N'期末' ORDER BY co.course_name
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Department
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Major
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Class
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Student
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Course
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Score
SELECT d.dept_name AS deptName, COUNT(m.major_id) AS cnt FROM Department d LEFT JOIN Major m ON d.dept_id = m.dept_id GROUP BY d.dept_name ORDER BY d.dept_name

SELECT d.dept_name AS deptName, COUNT(s.stu_id) AS cnt FROM Department d LEFT JOIN Major m ON d.dept_id = m.dept_id LEFT JOIN Class c ON m.major_id = c.major_id LEFT JOIN Student s ON c.class_id = s.class_id GROUP BY d.dept_name ORDER BY d.dept_name
SELECT course_type AS courseType, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Course GROUP BY course_type
